question: Does the owner-selected deliberate-Ward-investment to same-turn Ward-spend-finisher direction define one complete legal finite contract before any support or simulator row is read?

hypotheses.H0: The direction cannot be encoded with an exact current-main null, isolated realised-Ward producer, bounded spend, separate bounded payoff and natural cost.
hypotheses.H1: The frozen research-only consumer and four-cell spend/payoff grid form one complete legal contract with brace first and bulwark only as the automatic fallback producer level.

claimBoundary: Authority, exact-source interface, finite grammar, causal factors, aliases, estimands, budgets and automatic stop/go only. Zero support, simulator, endpoint, balance, product, protected-seed, #421 acceptance or P9 claim.

selectedContract.producer: Primary level: the realised return of gain_block_player from the unchanged current-main brace block effect. Conditional second level: the same realised return from unchanged bulwark, executed only if the complete brace capacity screen fails its frozen support gate. Other Ward sources never produce credit.
selectedContract.mediatorState: One combat-local player-private non-stacking record {source, credit, turn}. A qualifying producer replaces credit with its exact realised Ward gain; it never adds and is omitted from product projection and save state.
selectedContract.consumer: A later exact research421WardSpendFinisher Attack play in the same player turn. The research-only common one-energy card has fixed base damage 5 or 7 upgraded followed by one research421WardSpend special; it is injected into the Dusk research catalogue only and makes no product-ID or shipping-copy commitment.
selectedContract.payoffOperation: For spend S in {4,8}, require mediator credit and current Ward both at least S, subtract exactly S current Ward, consume the record, and request one separate hit_enemy operation with is_attack=false for S*N/2 where N in {1,2}. The four cells are (4,1)->2, (4,2)->4, (8,1)->4 and (8,2)->8 separate damage. Enemy Ward may absorb it; Fervor, Dimmed, Cracked, Attack chips and damage multipliers do not alter it.
selectedContract.lifecycleExpiry: Set after the exact producer Ward effect; replace on another exact configured producer; consume once during the exact consumer special; otherwise clear at player end turn, victory or loss. Wrong order, another turn, dead target or combat disposal cannot consume it.
selectedContract.naturalCost: Acquire and draw both cards through the normal Offering/deck/shuffle path, pay unchanged producer plus consumer energy, deliberately sequence producer before consumer, and lose exactly S current Ward. No start-of-fight grant, forced hand, free energy, generic threshold, relic, selector or persistent commitment is present.
selectedContract.duskBoundary: Duskblade aspect index 0 only. The research surface is not injected for Ashwarden; even a direct manually supplied research card has no Ward-spend semantic outside Dusk. Current-main content and authored card effects remain unchanged.
selectedContract.scorelineFactor: Fixed absent and off. Chisel, Executioner, Scoreline marks and Scoreline payoff remain closed and unchanged.
selectedContract.afterimageFactor: Fixed absent and off. Defend, Guarded Strike, Afterimage marks and Afterimage payoff remain closed and unchanged.
selectedContract.interferenceRule: Fortify, Guarded Strike, other Ward sources, start-of-fight Ward, potions, relics, card costs, rarities, pools, RNG and frozen policy identities do not create or enlarge producer credit. Fortify may change current Ward but not credit. No joint package cell is added before held-out shared anchors measure decision value.
selectedContract.nullPath: Default candidate code, mechanism absent/off, Ashwarden, wrong producer, wrong order, expired credit, dead target, credit below S or current Ward below S must preserve current-main path, RNG, non-research events and result exactly after research telemetry is removed. Producer observation with consumer off may emit telemetry only.
selectedContract.policyExposure: Enumerate the same 64 frozen current-policy identities for every contrast. The special's existing fallback acquisition score is identical in off and on arms; only the truthful preview of an enabled payable payoff may affect later actions. No priority, target, draw, acquisition, timing or score control is admitted before measured bottleneck evidence.

direct: none: no exact producer and effect off
A: exact producer then effect off
B: no exact producer then effect on
AB: exact producer then effect on
designMatrix.capacity: For brace first, compare the same injected surface with producer observation off versus brace observation on and consumer effect off. The on arm may emit opportunity telemetry but must preserve result and RNG. Run the identical bulwark rectangle only if brace fails the frozen support gate.
designMatrix.crn: For the selected producer level, one common producer-only/effect-off comparator is shared by the four complete spend/payoff cells on identical policy and simulation seed identities. This is a two-by-two consumer grid with a shared causal anchor, not the old four-factor design.
designMatrix.heldout: Only a single CRN-feasible candidate may enter a fresh equal-cohort held-out panel containing shared baseline and package-interference anchors. Additional joint cells require an anchor interval capable of changing admission.

mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: spend by payoff ratio: requested separate damage is their defined product and the two four-damage cells distinguish defence cost
producer by consumer effect: Ward can be spent only after exact realised producer credit

aliasStructure.producerOffConsumerOn: Exact null without producer credit; proved directly and omitted from whole-run CRN.
aliasStructure.consumerOffGrid: All spend/payoff levels alias the one producer-only comparator because no spend or payoff operation executes.
aliasStructure.bulwarkWithBrace: Not a joint factor. Bulwark is an automatic second producer level only after complete brace capacity futility.
aliasStructure.scorelineAfterimage: Fixed absent/off and never crossed in this family.

cohorts.freshness: The root is owner-comment ID modulo 2^31-1. The first seed is 600000 plus owner-comment ID modulo 300000. Exact protocol, runner and ledger field searches found no prior use of the root or four seed identities; protected ranges are excluded.

estimands.capacity: Counts of policies with producer exposure, consumer exposure, same-turn payable opportunity at S=4 and S=8, exact inactivity, viable opportunity and zero path/RNG mismatch.
estimands.quality: Win indicator plus terminal HP divided by terminal maximum HP.
estimands.primaryCrn: Within-policy mean AB-minus-producer-only quality for each cell, averaging the four matched simulation-seed differences before deterministic cluster bootstrap.
estimands.mechanism: Matched Ward-spend event and separate requested/realised damage effects, with exact producer-credit/spend/payoff cardinality.
estimands.policySensitivity: Counts of active viable policy-cluster quality effects above zero and of all policy-cluster effects at or below zero.
estimands.guardrails: Stall/error change, mean completed-fight turn change, Dusk Vow-5 win rate, RNG/policy identity and broad non-mediated movement.
estimands.notEstimatedBeforeHeldout: Ash separation beyond exact null, RandomBuild, independent replication, functional separation, real-economy reachability, detector admission, RC selection, product balance or P9.

gates.sourceAndDirect: Exact source/interface cardinality, comparator invariance, default and knob null identity, direct A/B/AB mechanism, insufficient-Ward, wrong-order, non-Dusk, expiry and Fortify isolation must all pass with zero faults.

capacity.selectedSpendRule: Retain every spend level meeting all capacity gates; no endpoint may select a level. If none passes brace, run bulwark. If none passes bulwark, close the family.

crn.effect: Lower 95% policy-cluster bounds for quality and separate realised payoff must exceed zero.
crn.selection: Among fully feasible cells, minimise separate damage, then maximise Ward spend, then canonical (spend,numerator) identity. Freeze at most one.

methodTrigger: ML, RL, BO, TPE or SMBO remains forbidden unless the complete valid experiment identifies a specific policy-repertoire bottleneck, the legal grammar and held-out recommendation test are frozen, and a separate matched-budget preregistration gives the method measured decision value.

automaticDisposition.success: Advance the sole feasible minimum through held-out package admission and the remaining #421 stages.
automaticDisposition.futility: On invalid source/null identity, behaviour drift, zero activation, insufficient capacity, causal futility or functional non-separation at its frozen cap, close this exact family without threshold, card, producer, payoff, cohort, policy or method rescue.
automaticDisposition.inconclusive: Record inconclusive at the preregistered cap without rerun, extra row, replacement cohort or method.
automaticDisposition.humanAuthority: Only after the complete family is validly exhausted, or work necessarily breaks save, internal ID or determinism, may the next concise human-authority package be raised.
